venues.name: SUNNY HILL FESTIVAL PARK
venues.description:
Sunny Hill Festival is the biggest music festival in Prishtina, Kosova and one of the leading music festivals in Southeast Europe. Founded by the Lipa family, the festival has been nominated three times among Europe’s Top 10 Best Mid-Sized Festivals. Throughout the years, the festival has placed Prishtina on the international festival map as a must-visit cultural destination in a country that loves music and knows how to have fun.

An international music festival of the highest standards, Sunny Hill brings together over 100,000 music lovers from all over the world in every edition to celebrate unforgettable performances, incredible energy, and a vibrant community.

With previous headliners including Dua Lipa, Miley Cyrus, Calvin Harris, Shawn Mendes, J Balvin, Anyma, Stormzy, Peggy Gou, Mochakk, Black Coffee, Burna Boy, FatboySlim, Martin Garrix, Hardwell and many more, the festival continues to bring global talent together with rising regional artists across multiple stages and immersive experiences.

The festival’s permanent home, Sunny Hill Festival Park in Bernica, offers an expanded experience across four stages the Main Stage, C4 Stage, Satellite Stage and Tent Stage - welcoming the biggest names in music along with emerging talent from the region and beyond.

The 2026 edition, taking place from July 31 to August 2, is set to be another massive celebration of music, culture, and community, with the first wave of artists already generating excitement worldwide.

Make this summer unforgettable at Sunny Hill Festival.

venues.name: edhe
venues.description: edhe Restaurant in Sofali, Prishtina, brings together delicious cuisine, a modern atmosphere, and outstanding hospitality. From everyday dining to special occasions, guests can enjoy quality dishes, refreshing beverages, and a welcoming environment designed for memorable moments.

venues.name: Vendum
venues.description: Vendum is a cozy gastropub located in the heart of Prishtina, known for its warm atmosphere, live music nights, great food, and welcoming social vibe. Combining quality cuisine, refreshing drinks, and regular entertainment, Vendum has become a favorite gathering spot for people looking to enjoy good company, local talent, and memorable evenings in the city center.

venues.name: Kultura House
venues.description: Kultura House is one of Prishtina’s most distinctive nightlife and cultural venues, bringing together electronic music, contemporary art, and immersive experiences in an industrial-inspired atmosphere. A space where creativity, community, and underground culture meet.

venues.name: Taverna Menata
venues.description: A cozy late-night tavern in Prishtina known for its relaxed atmosphere, outdoor seating, cold beers, and casual food. Located near Rruga B, Taverna Menata has become a popular spot for friends looking for a more laid-back nightlife experience outside the typical club scene. The venue stays open late and combines a traditional tavern vibe with a social nightlife atmosphere, especially during weekends.

venues.name: LIT
venues.description: **LIT Club** is one of Prishtina's vibrant late-night destinations, known for its energetic atmosphere, stylish interior, and music that keeps the crowd dancing until the early hours. Blending the feel of a modern lounge with the excitement of a nightclub, LIT offers an unforgettable nightlife experience featuring resident and guest DJs, premium drinks, and a lively social scene. Whether you're planning a night out with friends or celebrating a special occasion, LIT Club delivers the perfect mix of music, entertainment, and electric vibes in the heart of the city.

venues.name: BOUJEE
venues.description: Step into Boujee Lounge Club, one of Prishtina's premier nightlife destinations where luxury, music, and unforgettable experiences come together. With its sophisticated interior, elegant atmosphere, and high-energy vibe, Boujee offers the perfect setting for stylish nights out. From top local and international DJs spinning everything from hip-hop and Afrobeat to house and R&B, every night is designed to keep the energy alive until the early hours. Whether you're celebrating with friends or looking for the city's ultimate nightlife experience, Boujee Lounge Club delivers premium service, exceptional ambiance, and an electric atmosphere that makes every visit memorable.

venues.name: ZONE ELECTRONIC
venues.description:
Zone Electronic is a space for music, movement, freedom, and connection. We want everyone to feel comfortable, respected, and free to enjoy the night.

By entering, you agree to help us create a safe and welcoming atmosphere for everyone.

venues.name: Zone Club
venues.description: Zone Club Prishtina is a vibrant nightlife venue known for great music, energetic crowds, and unforgettable events. With top DJs, a modern atmosphere, and an electric party experience, it’s a go-to destination for nightlife lovers in Prishtina.

venues.name: ANZO
venues.description:
ANZO (short for Anzotika) is the Illyrian goddess of love, fertility, and unforgettable nights. She represents the divine feminine nourishment and passionate love, with some traditions associating her with guiding souls to the afterlife.

With a glass raised in one hand and a bottle in the other, she watches over every pour, every toast, and every perfect evening at ANZO — bringing ancient grace and modern pleasure together.

She's the spirit behind the bar. The muse of the moment. The queen of the night. 🍷

venues.name: PRIVIEW
venues.description: Perched above the city with one of Prishtina's most breathtaking panoramic views, Priview Bar & Lounge is the perfect destination for relaxing evenings and unforgettable nights out. Blending a modern atmosphere with exceptional service, Priview offers a carefully selected range of cocktails, wines, beers, and premium drinks, complemented by live music and an energetic ambiance. Whether you're enjoying a casual drink with friends, celebrating a special occasion, or taking in the city lights from above, Priview delivers a unique experience where great views, vibrant entertainment, and memorable moments come together.

events.title: MIROLOJA
events.description:
It’s so good to be back with a special one like this: @miroloja brothers from Paris, all night long open to close at @e.dh.e for @winmusicfreedomkosova presents @pribeats episode 28!
They are the duo behind the enigmatic labels OLO Records and Ninja Records, home to stellar releases over the years from the likes of @soundslikereboot , @janeret_ and our good friend @silatbeksii , in addition to many more by the bros themselves.
Beyond their own labels, over the last decade Miroloja have built a very impressive discography across some of the underground scene’s most respected music outlets, including Polyson of @cabanne_paris , Gettraum of @traumer_music , Infuse of @enzosiragusa , Solid Grooves of @michael_bibi_ , Joule Imprint of Janeret, as well as @yoyaku.fr and Les Enfants Records, the label of Barcelona’s Les Enfants Brillants club @lesenfantsclub .
Their perpetual b2b creates a one-of-a-kind blend of house music which has earned them widespread acclaim from critics and dancers alike on dancefloors across six continents.
We’re really excited to hear what they have in store for us as we bring back the open-to-close concept: one act, one full journey, 23:00 to 06:00. A platform for proper musical storytelling.
See you on the dancefloor at @e.dh.e on July 3!
Supported by @winmusicfreedomkosova , @starcard.teb , @redbullkosova , @ipko.rrethiyt
In partnership with @e.dh.e & @prifest
#PrishtinaBeats
Track ID: Percstherapy – Miroloja [OLO Records – 2023]
